sentences.en: Little do we realize how much we depend on bacteria.
sentences.zh: 我们实在没有意识到自己对细菌有多么依赖。

sentences.en: Sami injected bacteria in some of the pastries Layla ate.
sentences.zh: 萨米给莱拉吃的一些糕点里注射了细菌。

sentences.en: We evolved pathetically from the fucking bacteria we once were!
sentences.zh: 我们从那些曾经是的该死的细菌进化而来，真是可怜。
